title: Introduce epoched release manifests and anonymized sample digests
author: Priya Nair
description:
Motivation: onboarding churn and staged rollouts make changelogs noisy and hard to correlate with measured performance. This PR introduces 'epoched' release manifests (manifest_v2) and a digesting pipeline that emits privacy-preserving sample snapshots that are attached to release artifacts. Goals: 1) make release notes deterministic and replayable per epoch; 2) attach compact, anonymized sample digests that allow QA/SEs to re-run representative inputs without exposing raw customer data; 3) enable a changelog mirror that can publish concise per-epoch summaries for the Console and the public model catalog.

What changed (high-level): added a new manifest_v2 schema with epoch and provenance fields; migration to add epoch table; a background worker (chronicle) that synthesizes per-epoch diffs and generates anonymized sample digests (k-anonymity + token-redaction rules); CLI and SDK hooks to pin a model release to an epoch; Console docs and a new release-chronicle generator that compiles release notes from epoched profiles, perf deltas, and anonymized sample summaries.

Important design notes: sample digests are content-addressed (sha256) and store only hashed examples + light metadata (sequence length distribution, quantified latency percentiles, quantization-profile used). Raw samples are never stored in the registry; the digest generator applies deterministic redaction and numeric bucketing to prevent reconstruction. Epochs are monotonic integers per model-name + major-version and provide a stable anchor for rollbacks and canary comparisons.

Backward compatibility: manifests without epoch will be treated as epoch=0. The migration is additive; older registry clients continue to function. The Console has a migration compatibility layer that renders epoch=0 releases as before.

Ops & rollout plan: feature gated behind config flag registry.release_epochs; rollout to staging for 2 weeks, then gradual enable for 10% of new onboard flows; enable digest generation for internal-only releases first. The PR includes the migration and a reversible downgrade path (drop epoch table and conversion script).

Links: linear -> ENG-2147; design doc -> docs/registry/release-epochs.md; demo script -> cli/onboard --epoch 3 --pin
commits_summary: 5 commits: schema(manifest_v2) + migration; worker: chronicle digest generator; cli: epoch pin flag + tests; docs: release-epochs.md; small fixes after review (anonymization edge-cases).
release_notes: Adds epoched release manifests and anonymized sample digests. This enables deterministic per-epoch changelogs and privacy-preserving sample attachments for release audits. Migration is additive; enable via registry.release_epochs flag.
review_thread: Miguel Santos: Nice approach — epoch anchors will make rollbacks so much clearer. Two asks: add an integration test that validates digest reproducibility and document the k-anonymity parameters.
Priya Nair: Thanks — added tests/chronicle/test_digest_generation.py and documented parameters in release-epochs.md. The digest generator exposes K_FACTOR (default=5) and a bucketing policy.
Dana Cho: We need to be explicit about PII handling. Are we relying only on tokenization redaction? What about freeform fields in metadata?

Priya Nair: Good point. Updated the worker to run a metadata scrubber that drops freeform fields not in an allowlist and replaces strings over 64 chars with hashes. Added tests for long-field redaction.
Evan Li: CI failed on lint in first run (flake8 error in worker). Re-run required.
Priya Nair: Fixed lint and a race in the epoch table migration; re-ran CI and addressed transient DB ordering in the worker initialization.
ci_log_summary: Initial run: failing lint and one flaky DB test. After fixes: all checks passed (unit tests, integration tests for digest generation, schema validation, flake8). Recorded run id: ci/2468. Coverage delta +0.3%.
notes_for_changelog: Introduce epoched release manifests (manifest_v2) and anonymized sample digests. New CLI flag --epoch to pin releases. Add migration and background digest worker. Opt-in via registry.release_epochs. (ENG-2147)
deployment_notes: Feature gated. Run migration on the registry DB (migrations/2026_03_01_add_epoch_table.sql) during maintenance window; enable 'registry.release_epochs' flag in Console config; monitor chronicle.worker.count and digest-generation latency metric (chronicle.digest.latency).
security_review_notes: Anonymization reviewed by Dana Cho; added metadata allowlist and maximum field length checks. No secrets stored in digests; content-addressed hashes used for traceability.
qa_checklist:
1) migration runs cleanly on staging DB
2) digest generation produces k-anonymous outputs (k>=5)
3) Console renders epoched changelogs
4) CLI pin/unpin works across versions
5) rollback script validated
follow_up_tasks: ENG-2201: add UI for epoch comparison in Console
